launch_checklist: Resolve game-company dataset redistribution/commercial-use permission before broader reuse or promotion.
Keep A/B/C labels, company-only records without pins, duplicate warnings and per-source notices.
Review 13 legacy unknown-evidence locations individually; no automatic removals.
Resolve identity conflicts and corroborate actual physical facilities before upgrading a record.
Preserve all raw/reference IDs, original coordinates and evidence history during any correction.
Verify current provider notices and all inherited coordinate attribution.
Review canonical changes in a human-authorised PR; do not fabricate approval hashes.
Inspect required-review rules and bypass rights; current enforcement is unconfirmed.
Re-test deployed Pages after any authorised merge; this draft does not deploy.
